# ProfileBegin

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ProfileBegin:Void key:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | In | String | required | The name of the part. |

## Description

Starts timing a part of the program under a key of your own. The key is a name you choose, in any case, up to 63 characters, and up to 64 keys can be used; a key can not be the name of one of the runtime's items (see [ProfileItemName](ProfileItemName)). After [ProfileEnd](ProfileEnd) the time is added to the key for the frame, so a part that runs several times in a frame (or is started again later in it) adds up. The time for each frame is read with [ProfileValue](ProfileValue), listed by [ProfileSlow](ProfileSlow) and added up by the report of [ProfileFPS](ProfileFPS), next to the items of the runtime. Without `--profile` (or `-d`), or with the timers off ([ProfileEnable](ProfileEnable)), this command does nothing.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 64, 64, 0, 2
For i = 1 To 10
	ProfileBegin "ai"
	Delay 2 ; the part of the program that is measured
	ProfileEnd "ai"
	Cls
	Flip
	Print "ai took " + ProfileValue("ai") + " ms"
Next
```
